transparent-background.title: Make Image Background Transparent
transparent-background.seoTitle: Make Image Background Transparent Online | PixEasy
transparent-background.seoDescription: Remove a white, black, or solid-color background and save a transparent PNG. No AI or upload required.
transparent-background.description: Remove a white, black, or solid-color background and save the result as a transparent PNG. No AI or upload required.
explanation: Choose a solid background color and adjust tolerance and edge softness.
Optional edge-connected mode protects matching colors inside the subject.
transparent-background.about: PixEasy makes white, black, or another selected solid-color background transparent directly in your browser. It does not use AI and does not identify people or complex scenes. Choose a color, adjust tolerance and edge softness, and optionally limit removal to areas connected to the image edges. JPG, JPEG, PNG, and WebP input are supported without an intermediate conversion. Images never leave your device, and the result downloads as a full-resolution transparent PNG.

faqs.question: Is this an AI background remover?
faqs.answer: No. It removes pixels that match a selected solid color; it does not recognize people, objects, or complex backgrounds.

faqs.question: Can I remove colors other than white?
faqs.answer: Yes. Choose black, use the custom color picker, or click the original preview to sample a color.

faqs.question: How does the contiguous background option help?
faqs.answer: It removes matching areas connected to the image edges, helping preserve the same color inside the subject.

faqs.question: Will my image be uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Decoding, pixel processing, preview, and PNG creation happen locally in your browser.

compress.title: Compress Image
compress.seoTitle: Compress Image to a Target File Size | PixEasy
compress.seoDescription: Compress JPG, PNG, or WebP images to a target file size such as 500 KB. Free, private, and processed in your browser.
compress.description: Reduce large photos and images to the file size you need.
compress.purpose: Compress to a target file size
explanation: Adaptive compression searches for the best practical quality at or below your target.
If quality alone is not enough, optional dimension reduction preserves the aspect ratio.
compress.about: PixEasy compresses photos and images toward a target file size entirely in your browser. Adaptive quality search is used for JPG and WebP, while PNG remains lossless and keeps transparency by default. If a very small target cannot be reached at the original dimensions, optional proportional resizing can reduce the pixel dimensions. Your file is never uploaded, stored, or sent to an image-processing service.

faqs.question: Can I compress an image to exactly 500 KB?
faqs.answer: PixEasy searches for the closest practical result at or below 500 KB when the format and image content allow it. The actual size is always shown.

faqs.question: Will compression reduce image quality?
faqs.answer: Lossy JPG and WebP compression may remove some detail. Preview the result before downloading.

faqs.question: Does the tool change image dimensions?
faqs.answer: It first tries the original dimensions. If enabled and necessary, it reduces dimensions proportionally to approach a small target.

faqs.question: Why is PNG harder to compress?
faqs.answer: PNG uses lossless compression and may preserve transparency, so it often cannot reach targets that JPG or WebP can.

faqs.question: Are my photos uploaded to a server?
faqs.answer: No. Reading, compression, preview, and download creation happen locally in your browser.

invert.title: Invert Image
invert.seoDescription: Invert image colors online instantly. Free, private, browser-based image inverter with no uploads.
invert.description: Reverse every color in your image instantly — private, free, and watermark-free.
explanation: Inverting an image replaces each color with its opposite value, creating a familiar negative effect.
Everything happens in your browser, so the image never leaves your device.
invert.about: PixEasy’s invert image tool reverses the red, green, and blue values in a photo to create a color-negative effect. It is useful for creative graphics, film-negative previews, scientific imagery, and revealing contrast. Upload a JPG, PNG, or WebP, compare the preview, and download PNG or JPG. Processing happens entirely inside your browser. Your image is never uploaded, stored, or added to an account. The tool is free and adds no watermark.

faqs.question: What is image inversion?
faqs.answer: It replaces every color with its opposite value, producing an effect similar to a photographic negative.

faqs.question: Can I invert PNG images?
faqs.answer: Yes. PNG input and output are supported, including transparency.

faqs.question: Does PixEasy upload my files?
faqs.answer: No. Processing happens locally in your browser.

grayscale.title: Grayscale Image
grayscale.seoDescription: Create a grayscale or black-and-white image online. Free, private, and processed locally in your browser.
grayscale.description: Create a balanced black-and-white image using weighted luminance.
explanation: Weighted luminance creates a natural black-and-white result.
Compare the preview before saving as PNG or JPG.
grayscale.about: PixEasy converts color images into balanced grayscale using weighted luminance, reflecting how people perceive brightness. Use it for black-and-white portraits, simplified graphics, reference images, contrast checks, or a classic monochrome look. JPG, PNG, and WebP are supported, and transparent PNG pixels remain transparent with PNG output. All work runs locally in your browser. PixEasy does not upload, inspect, or store your image. There is no account, payment, or watermark.

faqs.question: How is grayscale created?
faqs.answer: PixEasy uses weighted luminance for a natural brightness balance.

faqs.question: Can PNG transparency be preserved?
faqs.answer: Yes. Choose PNG output to preserve transparency.

faqs.question: Are my photos private?
faqs.answer: Yes. They are processed locally and never uploaded.

jpg-png.title: JPG to PNG
jpg-png.seoTitle: JPG to PNG Converter Online Free | PixEasy
jpg-png.seoDescription: Convert JPG to PNG online for free. Preserve the original image or explicitly remove a white background.
jpg-png.description: Convert JPG to lossless PNG, with optional white background removal.
explanation: Transparent mode removes white only when you select it.
jpg-png.about: PixEasy converts JPG and JPEG images into PNG files directly in your browser. Standard PNG preserves every pixel, including white objects and backgrounds. Transparent PNG can remove white and near-white backgrounds with adjustable tolerance and a checkerboard preview. It is useful for logos, product graphics, and screenshots while keeping normal conversion safe by default. Your image is never uploaded or stored. Conversion is free, requires no signup, and produces a full-resolution PNG without a watermark.

faqs.question: Does standard conversion remove white pixels?
faqs.answer: No. Standard PNG preserves all white and off-white pixels.

faqs.question: How do I create transparency?
faqs.answer: Choose Transparent PNG and adjust the tolerance.

faqs.question: Is my JPG uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Conversion happens locally.

png-jpg.title: PNG to JPG
png-jpg.seoTitle: PNG to JPG Converter Online Free | PixEasy
png-jpg.seoDescription: Convert PNG to JPG online for free. Choose a background and JPG quality with private browser processing.
png-jpg.description: Convert PNG to JPG and choose how transparent areas should look.
explanation: Choose a background for transparent pixels.
Adjust quality to balance detail and file size.
png-jpg.about: PixEasy turns PNG images into widely compatible JPG files without sending them to a server. Because JPG cannot contain transparency, choose a white, black, or custom background before conversion. The live preview shows the result and quality control balances detail and size. This is useful for websites, email, social platforms, and services that accept JPG. All decoding and encoding happen locally. PixEasy never uploads or stores your PNG, requires no account, and adds no watermark.

faqs.question: What happens to transparent areas?
faqs.answer: They use the background color you select.

faqs.question: What quality should I choose?
faqs.answer: About 90% is a strong default.

faqs.question: Will dimensions change?
faqs.answer: No. The original width and height are preserved.

resize.title: Resize Image
resize.seoDescription: Resize images and photos online by width, height, or exact pixels. Free, private, and browser based.
resize.description: Set a width, height, or exact dimensions and preview the result live.
explanation: Set width or height to preserve aspect ratio.
Choose exact dimensions for a fixed size.
resize.about: PixEasy resizes JPG, PNG, and WebP images to the pixel dimensions you need. Set width or height while preserving aspect ratio, or choose exact dimensions for a fixed canvas. Preview the result before downloading PNG or JPG. Resizing is useful for websites, profile photos, email, presentations, and marketplace listings. Processing takes place entirely in your browser. Your image is not uploaded, inspected, or stored. The resizer is free, needs no account, and adds no watermark.

faqs.question: Can I resize without stretching?
faqs.answer: Yes. Set width or height to preserve aspect ratio.

faqs.question: Which formats are supported?
faqs.answer: JPG, PNG, and WebP input with PNG or JPG output.

faqs.question: Are resized images uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Resizing happens locally.
